characterization_methods: Inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectroscopy (ICP-AES)
evidence: Images were taken of the uncoated substrates with an atomic force microscope (AFM; Park Systems XE-100) in order to clear their surface morphologies. Inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectroscopy (ICP-AES) analyses were carried out in order to determine the amount of aluminum in the ALD-Al2O3 deposited samples. The thicknesses of the deposited films were measured from Si(100) reference samples by spectroscopic ellipsometry. All the samples together with the uncoated substrate materials used were characterized for their oxygen transmission rate (OTR) expressed as cm3/m2/105 Pa/day and water vapor transmission rate (WVTR) expressed as g/m²/day.
